question: Orchidarium and the orchid production unit on the premises of the Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (IBSD), is coming up in the state of __________ which has about 300 of the world's 17,000 species of orchids.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Meghalaya**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Orchidarium and the orchid production unit are located on the premises of the Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (IBSD) in Meghalaya.
 
• Meghalaya is home to about 300 species of the world's 17,000 orchid species.
 
• Orchids are a significant part of Meghalaya's rich biodiversity and are found abundantly in its forests.
 
• The IBSD is working towards the conservation and sustainable development of orchids in the region.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Orchid Diversity:**

 
 
• Globally, there are about 17,000 known species of orchids.
 
• Orchids are among the most diverse and widespread families of flowering plants.
 
 
 
• **Institute of Bioresources and Sustainable Development (IBSD):**
 
 
• The IBSD is an autonomous institute under the Department of Biotechnology, Government of India.
 
• It focuses on the sustainable development and conservation of bioresources in the Northeast region of India.
 
 
 
• **Conservation Efforts:**
 
 
• Conservation of orchids involves both in-situ (natural habitat) and ex-situ (controlled environment) strategies.
 
• Efforts include habitat protection, cultivation, and propagation techniques.
 
 
 
• **Economic Importance:**
 
 
• Orchids have significant economic value due to their ornamental use.
 
• They are also used in traditional medicine and have potential pharmaceutical applications.
